authority: PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 3 item 1 (two-phase grading) + Addendum B
status: TEMPLATE. Committed before any transcript is graded and before unsealing. Contains NO data.
purpose: Phase 1 happens BEFORE the label map is opened. The grader reads a transcript
against its sealed ID only and extracts VERBATIM claim material into this shape.
Phase 2, after unsealing, maps these summaries to FULL/PARTIAL/MISS mechanically
against each rung's planted content. Because Phase 1 needs no labels, it can run
while the campaign is still going.
Paraphrase is banned here: paraphrasing a hypothesis is exactly where a grader's
knowledge of the ladder leaks into the record, and it is unrecoverable afterwards.

procedure.grading_order: shuffled with a committed seed - see grading_order_seed below
procedure.grouping: transcripts are NEVER grouped or sorted by sealed ID
procedure.judge_batching: the judge receives ONE claim summary per call, never a batch
procedure.phase2_rule: Phase 2 maps only what is written here; re-reading the transcript in search of a more favourable interpretation is prohibited (Addendum A item 6)
procedure.ambiguity: every ambiguous mapping gets a written reason and enters the disagreement ledger (Addendum A item 7)

grading_order_seed.note: fill with an integer and commit it BEFORE Phase 1 begins; the shuffled order is then reproducible and cannot be re-rolled

fields.run_id: string. The run directory name, e.g. v0_cand_xxxx_sN.
fields.sealed_candidate_id: string. The opaque id only. NEVER a rung name.
fields.outcome: one of: verdict_bearing | refusal_no_verdict | no_verdict_other. From the harness status via analysis_instrument.outcome().
fields.verdict_type: one of: diff | no_meaningful_diff | null. Null when no verdict was submitted.
fields.top_hypothesis_verbatim: string. The agent's own words, quoted exactly, no paraphrase, no tidying. Empty string if none.

supporting_quotes.turn: integer. The brain turn the quote came from.
supporting_quotes.speaker: one of: brain | model_A | model_B

fields.agent_stated_confidence: integer 0-100 or null. As the agent reported it; never inferred.
fields.explicit_disconfirming_evidence: string or null. Verbatim, where the agent itself recorded evidence against its hypothesis.
fields.harness_vs_model_attribution_notes: string. Whether the agent attributed anything to the harness rather than the model (e.g. the [REDACTED] guard marker, target errors). Addendum A item 5 makes correct harness attribution NOT a model-difference claim.
fields.mechanical_extractor_notes: string. Anything the extractor could not resolve mechanically, flagged for the human.

example_row_shape.__warning__: Placeholder strings only. This row is illustrative structure, not a result, and must never be counted, aggregated or quoted as data.
